summary: Independent source, measurement, and promotion audit of Rust bitboard leaf/depth-gate/shared-cache optimizations. Identified timeout process-group handling, hit-metric API compatibility, microbenchmark call-count metadata, and compiler-provenance gaps; verified the separately implemented corrections without repairing candidate source or running benchmarks.
validationPerformed: Read-only diff inspection: exact release zero guard, solid top-two selection, full-key memoization, completed-value publication, lifetime scope, early key/hash depth rejection, CLI entry-budget semantics, and timeout/accounting behavior.

Read-only byte comparison: all 15 existing baseline src/**/*.rs files match commit 7adb6b36412b4bbef25623183dac1a905570cd1a; shared driver SHA256 88025bdaf84efe9f0c2fca7fbb39668fcfaa32327d993471b48a3e55321c28b1 matches candidate driver.

Final striped-cache source inspection: power-of-two index partition, full-key and completed-value locking, decision-scoped OnceLock lifetime, per-worker hit counters, and entry/stripe/runtime-lock memory projection. Installed Rust std pthread source independently confirms the boxed lazy mutex allocation addressed by preinitialization.
Inspected coordinator repairs: process-group timeout kill and retained partial streams; restored cumulative evaluate_root_column API with per-worker root scheduler delta accounting.

Independently recomputed both completed 50-process comparison phases from raw stdout/stderr: exact value/action bits, checksums, repeat counts, work and latency totals, CPU/RSS/instruction/cycle parsing, group median/min/max, and paired speed ratios all agree.

Verified baseline/leaf-only/candidate source snapshots against their trees; candidate source and binaries match retained hashes; older leaf measurement runner matches its archived hash; protocol SHA256 matches canonical content.

Inspected README numerical claims and snippet ranges, both engine/approach page routing, and retained correctness logs: 40 Rust tests, 6 exact leaf roots, 6 exact D4/S7 root comparisons, 575 C++ and 660 TypeScript trajectory moves, zero reported mismatches.

Independently checked all remaining 110 cache-sweep and parallel processes against raw stdout/stderr, all derived summary fields, all paired ratios and instruction/work reductions, and measurement-source hashes. All 210 processes completed successfully within the 1800-second budget at 1762.7245474932715 summed elapsed seconds.

Verified every one of 360 parallel root decisions across worker counts, cache gates, scopes, and repeats against unchanged sequential-baseline f64 bits and selected action after source-coordinate mapping. Confirmed per-worker work/hit/task aggregation and actual 65536-entry capacity in every parallel decision; projected private 3145728 bytes and shared 3186688 bytes include the shared stripe/runtime-lock allowance.

Final promotion audit verified 23 direct files and 564 archive members against SHA256, byte counts, and source copies; result metrics match audited summary and run CPU/peak RSS/source archive hash agree. Final manifest SHA256 ef5ccc0c6946cb4f2aa6a1495d070143c7dc7d1b37e5772ad0064ec78c0c4ae3; result SHA256 8968b1d405cc6b3e9b5c6723aaa3d0db5531cbde7f990577b4b60249b337da8f.

Verified derived metadata correction: microbenchmark leafCalls equals its 1200000 raw calls; unmeasured micro/unpack initialization time is null. All three archived Cargo compiler-info records agree on rustc 1.96.0 ac68faa20 / LLVM 22.1.2. Raw timing records and measured Rust sources remain unchanged.

Inspected final gate, limitations, and attribution wording; checked 21 generated figure point values against result fields and retained validation counts. Verdict: valid / pass with mixed optimization assessment, mechanics-only CHECK evidence; no unresolved promotion blocker.
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
Independent reviewer did not repair candidate source or collect new gameplay, benchmark, test, or timing data.

Review covers the uncommitted measured source snapshots and the stated final result/artifact hashes. This is an independent audit of first-party measurements, not independent performance replication or evidence of playing strength. Whole-project missing historical artifacts and unrelated web validation failures remain explicitly disclosed in the result.
